No FAIL findings. No UNKNOWN findings.

- The green isolated test DLL is absent. The TRX and its hash remain.

- The red verdict body is stored on the parent Codex execution turn. The GrokCode reviewer turns are canceled stubs.
- This terminal verdict was not written to the repository or the session log. The assignment forbids repository, TODO, requirement, plan, and HANDOFF writes.
